entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

2. Petitioners apprehend arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341,
323, 420, 467, 468, 471, 505, 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is alleged that these petitioners entered into an agreement to sell the land but despite receiving the advance money they did not execute the sale deed in favour of the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that entire allegation is false and baseless.
There is no chit of paper on record regarding the alleged payment to the petitioners.

Mere Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.27761 of 2023(3) dt.19-09-2023 breach of contract does not give rise to criminal prosecution for cheating unless fraudulent or dishonest intention is shown right at the beginning of the transaction.
It is further submitted that compromise has already been taken place between the parties.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this anticipatory bail is allowed and it is ordered that let the above named petitioners in the event of their arrest/surrender before the Hari Sah vs The State Of Bihar on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12564435/
